ABOUT_DESC:
Hi! I'm **Naura Hoshino**, built by **Aryandita** for Discord communities.

Here's what I can do:

**🤖 AI Chat**
Powered by Google Gemini. Holds conversation context across messages.

**🎶 Music Playback**
Streams audio via *Lavalink*. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, and Spotify.

**💰 RPG Economy**
Rotating shops, inventory, fishing, car racing, and bank heists.

**🎙️ Temp Voice Rooms**
Creates private voice channels on demand with a control panel (lock, hide, stage mode).

**🛡️ Moderation**
Anti-nuke, automod, and message filters.

Type `/core help` to see all commands. ✨

HELP_CAT_RECOVERY_DESC: Emergency recovery tools for mass ban, role restore, and channel backup.
HELP_CONTENT_RECOVERY:
{emoji:recycle|♻️} **Disaster Recovery & Emergency Restoration**

Tools to recover server from disasters like mass bans, channel nukes, or lost role assignments.

• `/recovery unban-all` - Mass unban all currently banned users in the server
• `/recovery snapshot-roles` - Backup all member role assignments for later restoration
• `/recovery restore-roles` - Restore role assignments from the latest snapshot
• `/recovery list-snapshots` - View list of saved recovery snapshots
• `/recovery config [retention_days]` - Configure how long snapshots are kept (1-365 days)

💡 **Tip:** Use `/recovery snapshot-roles` regularly as preventive backup before risky operations like `/moderation roleall`.

• `/survival study` - Study at Pratama academy for certifications and career advancements
• `/survival pet` / `farm` / `drone` - Tame wild animal companions, tend hydroponic greenhouse crops, and manage automated farming drones

**Combat Expeditions & Arena:**
• `/survival dungeon` - Explore procedural monster dungeons with Canvas visual cards
• `/survival activity abyss` - Co-op multi-floor The Neo-Abyss Celestial Raid
• `/survival raid` - Server-wide World Boss subjugation battle
• `/survival arena` / `duel` - Tactical coliseum combat and 1v1 PvP player duels

**Unified Economy, Community & Clans:**

• `/survival bank` - Deposit, withdraw, term savings, and official currency exchange bridge (NSF <-> Coin)

• `/clan` / `/survival town` - Found clans, customize Guild Hall, and visit Town Square
